modelingNotes: Exact bare relay C7-A20X/230VAC. WoR3.2 page69 selects AgNi (material digit0), LED-only X and 230 V AC, standard catalog 50 Hz selection. Source voltage-token order is interpreted using the manufacturer's explicit selection row; original source spelling is preserved. Installed revision is not established.

Model keys are physical relay pin numbers, matching the socket side of the interface. IEC function designations are descriptive aliases, not additional terminals. No pin viewing orientation beyond the manufacturer numbered diagram is asserted.
Physical-to-IEC map: 5=11, 1=12, 3=14, 6=21, 2=22, 4=24, 7=A1, 8=A2. Socket clamps and accessories are separately ordered and excluded.

WoR3.2 page11 distinguishes X from DX/FX. X includes LED indication with rectification; it does not add freewheeling suppression or a universal polarity requirement. Generic A1(+) convention in the family figure is not proof that this X variant requires a polarized supply. The coil symbol abstracts internal indication/rectification.

Only coil pins are required by library policy. Contacts are application-dependent. All contacts and coil/LED/rectifier paths remain distinct nets; no permanent fixed links. Shared physical commons and coil actuation are retained.
Coil selection230 VAC; catalog standard50 Hz, separately ordered60 Hz not inferred. Range0.8–1.1Un; AC consumption1.2 VA. Nominal coil voltage applies only to the coil.
Contact capabilities:10 A at250 VAC AC-1 or30 VDC DC-1; inrush30 A/20 ms; DC inductive limits depend on the page69 curve. No unconditional contact current or voltage scalar is assigned.

connectionCoverage.notes: All 8 bare-relay physical pins from exact selection and numbered diagram inventoried. Integrated X indication uses the existing coil pins. Separate socket and accessories excluded.
